title: Apartments along 15-501
summary: Rezones wooded parcels near the 15-501 corridor for mid-rise apartment buildings.

how: Planning staff review the rezoning application.
The Planning Commission reviews the proposal and makes a recommendation.
Residents comment at a Town Council public hearing.
Town Council votes on the rezoning.

pros: Places homes along an existing major road.
cons: At 20 acres, removes about 14 acres of tree canopy.
Adds car trips on 15-501 and the roads that feed it.
Mid-rise buildings change the look of the corridor.
